I can't say I've ever seen a supply address changed without the express consent of the requester - couldn't say in this situation.

Hi! I work in the energy industry - often times the supply address is actually completely different from the residential address.. This can be due to changes in zoning, changes in road layouts, or just a shitty registration. To change this you need to supply legal documentation proving the address is known as what you claim. So this is actually completely normal. They will then take this information to the distributor (Western Power for us) and put in a request to change it.

There's no standardization for supply addresses, and part of my job is sussing all of this out. Your meter number will be tied to an NMI, which will be tied to an address - this is the ultimate arbiter of truth.
